description: Lover. She went pastel and political and it's all a little soft. Some real songs buried in here, Cruel Summer and The Archer carry weight. But the album as a whole is overstuffed, bloated, needs an edit. I know about album vision, I built My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy as one piece. This is a playlist. There's a great EP hiding in a mediocre album. Greatest artist would've trimmed the fat.
